title: Al filament-induced unipolar resistive switching in sputtered Al-rich AlN memristors with low operating voltage and high memory window
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,44541-44547
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05691H, Paper
Open Access

Ankang Xiao, Luyu Zhao, Ying Yang, Cai Jin, Xiaoqin Yang, Lili Ma, Feifei Tian, Wei Hu, Zengli Huang, Hong Gu
Al-rich aluminum nitride (AlN) films were deposited on W/Ti/SiO2/Si substrates using magnetron sputtering to fabricate unipolar memristors with low switching voltages and a significant memory window.
